description: Australia: Lifetime Health Cover (LHC) loading on private hospital cover (privatehealth.gov.au; Department of Health 2026 new-migrant fact sheet). Base day = 1 July after the 31st birthday, or for a new migrant the later of that and 12 months after Medicare registration; joining after it adds 2% for each year over 30 (age on the 1 July before joining), up to 70%, removed after 10 continuous years; the loading applies to the hospital premium and the rebate does not reduce it. Reproduces the government's worked examples. Use this when someone asks what LHC loading they will pay or when their LHC deadline is.
